name: Windows Defender Protections Disabled via PowerShell
description: Detects use of the Set-MpPreference PowerShell cmdlet to disable real-time monitoring, script scanning, or other Windows Defender protections, a common pre-payload defense-impairment step. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_win_defender_disabled.yml, compiled from Sigma via sigma-cli (eql, ecs_windows pipeline).
query: any where (process.executable.caseless like~ ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe")) and process.command_line:"*Set-MpPreference*" and (process.command_line like~ ("*-DisableRealtimeMonitoring*", "*-DisableScriptScanning*", "*-DisableIOAVProtection*", "*-DisableBehaviorMonitoring*"))
false_positives: Administrators tuning Defender exclusions for a legitimate performance reason
author: Sentinel
